name: review
description: Comprehensive multi-phase PR review — change analysis with risk_class routing, 3-pass deep code review, risk-gated quality-review passes (domain-architecture, data-contracts, ops-reliability, change-evolution), security scanning (OWASP deepen), and documentation-drift checks, posted as one unified GitHub review. Test execution and coverage analysis are left to CI. Plus monitor-pr: continuously watch a PR for CI failures and review comments (drive with /loop), fix them via subagents in parallel, and resolve or reply-acknowledge each comment once its fix ships. Rust and Machinify mac-ui changes get tailored checks.
